// Moore finite state machine, one bit outputs for each state. Same as the
// previous combinational FSM, just written out explicitly as a register
// chain, for comparison.
module TopModule(
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  bump_left,
    input  bump_right,
    input  ground,
    output reg walk_left,
    output reg walk_right,
    output reg aaah
);
    reg [1:0] state, next_state;
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            2'd0: begin walk_left = 1; walk_right = 0; aaah = 0; next_state = bump_left ? 2'd1 : (bump_right ? 2'd2 : 2'd0); end
            2'd1: begin walk_left = 0; walk_right = 1; aaah = 0; next_state = bump_left ? 2'd1 : (bump_right ? 2'd2 : (ground ? 2'd0 : 2'd3)); end
            2'd2: begin walk_left = 1; walk_right = 0; aaah = 0; next_state = bump_left ? 2'd1 : (bump_right ? 2'd2 : (ground ? 2'd0 : 2'd3)); end
            2'd3: begin walk_left = 1; walk_right = 0; aaah = 1; next_state = bump_left ? 2'd1 : (bump_right ? 2'd2 : 2'd0); end
        endcase
    end
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (areset) state <= 2'd0;
        else state <= next_state;
    end
endmodule

module TopModule(
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  bump_left,
    input  bump_right,
    input  ground,
    output reg walk_left,
    output reg walk_right,
    output reg aaah
);
    reg [1:0] state;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (areset) state <= 2'b00;
        else case (state)
            2'b00: begin walk_left <= 1; walk_right <= 0; aaah <= 0; if (bump_left) state <= 2'b01; else if (bump_right) state <= 2'b10; else if (!ground) state <= 2'b00; end
            2'b01: begin walk_left <= 0; walk_right <= 1; aaah <= 0; if (bump_right) state <= 2'b10; else if (bump_left) state <= 2'b00; else if (!ground) state <= 2'b01; end
            2'b10: begin walk_left <= 0; walk_right <= 1; aaah <= 0; if (bump_left) state <= 2'b00; else if (bump_right) state <= 2'b10; else if (!ground) state <= 2'b10; end
            2'b11: begin walk_left <= 1; walk_right <= 0; aaah <= 1; if (ground) state <= 2'b00; end
        endcase
    end
endmodule
